caption: The drawing depicts a single, transparent green glass bowl with a wide, flaring rim and a short, circular base. The bowl has a smooth surface with subtle, swirling patterns on the glass, visible due to its transparency and the way light is reflected and refracted through it. The color is a consistent light green, and the bowl's shape is round, with inwardly curving sides and an outward-thrusting rim. The composition centers the bowl on a plain, light background, with no additional objects or decorative elements present. The shadows and highlights enhance the glass texture and give the bowl a three-dimensional appearance.
title: Bowl
